events.title: Grandma Left Me A Building Prologue Launches on November 4
events.summary: Hello landlords!We are excited to announce that the Grandma Left Me A Building Prologue will be available on November 4.Your grandma left you a building, and it's falling apart. In the Prologue, you get the keys and start bringing the place back to life. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the building, and decide how to handle whatever the day throws at you.Every tenant has their own traits, quirks and needs, and they all have to live next to each other. events.title: Demo Update v1.5: Seven New Languages, Steam Deck Support, Grandma's Notebook
events.summary: This is our biggest update yet. The game now speaks seven more languages, runs natively on Steam Deck, and Grandma's notebook is finally open. As always, a good part of the fixes below came straight from your reports. Here is what changed. Seven new languagesThe game is now playable in Italian, Latin American Spanish, Polish, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese. And yes, your reports drove a good chunk of this one too. Here is what changed.
